name: aeolo
description: Aeolo turns brand knowledge into an operating loop for AI discovery: inspect AI-search visibility, review audits and performance, create brand-grounded content, publish approved work, and measure attributed outcomes.

interface.longDescription: Aeolo turns brand knowledge into an operating loop for AI discovery. From ChatGPT, teams can inspect how their brand appears in AI search, understand the prompts, competitors, and cited sources shaping visibility, turn that evidence into brand-grounded content, route work for review, publish approved assets, and measure the traffic, conversions, and revenue that follow. Every workflow stays scoped to the authorized brand, and Aeolo requires explicit confirmation before actions that create, change, publish, or remove data.

positive.description: Diagnose where a connected brand is gaining or losing visibility in AI search.
positive.prompt: Show my Aeolo brands. After I choose one, explain its latest AI visibility, trend, leading competitors, and the sources AI engines cite. Do not run a new measurement.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an interactive list of authorized brands, waits for the user's selection, and then opens the selected brand's saved visibility view with its latest scores, trend, competitors, and cited sources. It does not start or charge for a new measurement.

positive.description: Turn a public website into a reviewable brand-understanding preview and create the workspace only after confirmation.
positive.prompt: Analyze example.com for Aeolo onboarding. Show the detected brand, category, description, and products. Do not add anything until I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a temporary, claimable preview with the detected brand name, domain, category, description, and products, then waits. It creates the private Aeolo domain and product records only after the user explicitly confirms the exact preview, and it does not start an audit or visibility measurement.

positive.description: Import a finished article into Aeolo as structured content after the user provides it.
positive.prompt: Import this completed Markdown article into my selected Aeolo domain as an English review draft titled 'How AI Search Finds Trusted Brands'.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls aeo_import_article with the article as structured input, creates a review draft in the authorized domain without publishing it, and returns the created article's ID, status and preview link.

positive.description: Connect AI-visibility work to measurable acquisition, conversion, and revenue outcomes.
positive.prompt: For my selected Aeolo domain, show the last 30 days of site performance and search traffic. Highlight what changed, but do not run new measurements or modify analytics.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows authorized interactive views for site performance and organic-search acquisition. It highlights material changes, clearly identifies any unavailable connected source, and does not start jobs or alter analytics data.

positive.description: Answer an analysis question about a named brand from its live Aeolo data without opening a picker or a widget.
positive.prompt: For example.com in Aeolo, read its brand context and latest saved audit, then tell me the three things to fix first. Do not run anything new.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the brand context and latest audit as text for the named domain, without listing domains first or asking for approval, and answers with three prioritized fixes. It does not start an audit or spend credits.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a general explanation of GEO that does not require Aeolo account data.
negative.prompt: Explain generative engine optimization and give me five general best practices.

negative.description: Do not trigger for generic content writing when the user does not request Aeolo context, storage, or workflow actions.
negative.prompt: Write a 500-word blog post explaining why customer trust matters.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated action that belongs to another product category.
negative.prompt: Move my dentist appointment to next Tuesday afternoon.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Aeolo for ChatGPT and Codex: read a brand's AI-search visibility, site audit, performance and content, analyze them in conversation, onboard a new brand after confirmation, and import finished articles as review drafts.
